currentParagraphText: “Good to see you too, Minaga,” the Sword Saint said as he sat cross-legged, bathing in the energy of the formation Dina had set up to help them recover faster. “May I ask the purpose of your impromptu visit?”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Oh, sure, sure,” Minaga said, keeping his big grin. “You two have been invited to a very prestigious party.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Looking behind them, he saw the carnage from their battle and the two dead pegasi. “Ah, doing a bit of culling of the local pegasi population. Understandable. Those damn things reproduce like rabbits.”
